title: lonicera alpigena subsp. glutinosa
intro: Lonicera alpigena subsp. glutinosa, commonly known as the Alpine Honeysuckle, is a flowering shrub native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera alpigena subsp. glutinosa are attributed to its ability to soothe respiratory issues, reduce fever, and aid in wound healing, among other uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
